verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device model and inference platform that markets an "Automation Foundation Model", so asking about autonomous background automations is a fair question for it. The evidence shows only tool-calling SDK primitives, such as decorating functions so that run() completes the tool loop, plus fine-tuning APIs. Those are developer building blocks for constructing automations, not a documented feature for setting up recurring or background automations, and nothing shows scheduling, triggers or unattended background execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
